segments.name: Union Bank
products: Telephone, internet, and mobile banking services
segments.description: A community bank providing retail, commercial, municipal banking and wealth management and trust services to individuals, businesses and municipalities in northern Vermont and northern New Hampshire.
segments.evidence: The Company has one definable business segment, Union Bank, which provides full retail, commercial, municipal banking, and wealth management and trust services throughout its 18 branch banking locations, three loan centers, and several ATMs covering northern Vermont and northern New Hampshire.

revenueModel.text: The company earns income principally from interest and fees on loans and earnings on other investments, paid by retail, commercial and municipal borrowers and deposit customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's income is derived principally from interest and fees on loans and earnings on other investments.
